      client,

entries.name: wf3-definer-stored-state
entries.claim: The definer names a move only when the stored row is already in the target state.
entries.original:
AND r.%1$I = $4
        AND r.%3$I = $6', identity_column, physical_table, state_column)
entries.replacement:
AND r.%1$I = $4
        AND $6 IS NOT NULL', identity_column, physical_table, state_column)

kills.expected: Missing expected rejection: a move the stored row has not made was named
